# SlopiFY

> SlopiFY is a private communal music streaming web application built with React, Vite, Vercel, and Firebase.

SlopiFY allows users to stream high-quality audio tracks, upload multi-format music (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG), manage communal playlists, and interact with a modern dark blueberry themed interface.

## Key Features & Pages

- [Library](https://slopify-nu.vercel.app/library): Stream communal music tracks, perform instant client-side filtering, and manage saved music collections.
- [Upload](https://slopify-nu.vercel.app/upload): Drag-and-drop audio uploader featuring client-side metadata parsing (ID3/FLAC tags) and automatic album art extraction.
- [Playlists](https://slopify-nu.vercel.app/playlists): Manage custom audio playlists, add/remove songs, and stream custom queues.

## Architecture & Source Code

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Slopify071/SlopiFY): Source code repository containing React components, custom hooks, and deployment configurations.
- [Live Web App](https://slopify-nu.vercel.app): Deployed application hosted on Vercel.
